programmes.amount_note: EUR 50,000 equity-free funding for product and IP development, plus up to two years of incubation with technical support from ESA experts, business coaching, legal and IPR advice and fundraising support. Some national BICs add local top-up funding.
programmes.deadline_note: This ESA BIC runs its own call cycle with published cut-off dates, typically two to four per year. Contact the local centre for the next deadline.

Submit application documents before the local deadline
Tender Opening Board review, then presentation to the Tender Evaluation Board
Register a company in Poland before signing the incubation contract

eligibility.other_note: Business must use space-based systems, apply space technology in a non-space domain, or develop products and services for the space sector. Company must be registered in Poland.

programmes.reopen_note: Individual BRIdge Alfa vehicles may still invest from existing capital; new fund-selection rounds under FENG are handled via PFR Ventures instruments rather than NCBR.

programmes.name_en: Polish Investment Zone – income tax exemption for new investments
programmes.funder: Ministerstwo Rozwoju i Technologii, through the Special Economic Zone managers; promoted by PAIH
programmes.amount_note: A CIT/PIT exemption rather than a cash award. The value equals a percentage of eligible investment costs set by the 2022-2027 regional aid map: up to 50% in eastern/north-eastern regions, 40% in industrial regions, 30% in mid-tier areas and 25% or less in wealthier regions, plus 20 percentage points for small enterprises and 10 for medium ones. Minimum investment outlays depend on company size and local unemployment (from PLN 0.2 million for micro enterprises in high-unemployment areas up to PLN 2 million in low-unemployment regions). Exemption periods run 12-15 years.
programmes.deadline_note: Applications for a decyzja o wsparciu are processed continuously by the Special Economic Zone managers acting on behalf of the Minister of Development and Technology.

procedure_steps.detail: Confirm the project counts as a new investment (new facility, capacity expansion, product diversification, fundamental process change, or acquisition of assets of a closed facility) and is not in an excluded sector.
Check the minimum investment outlay for your company size and county unemployment rate, and the qualitative criteria.
Apply to the Special Economic Zone manager covering the investment location for a decyzja o wsparciu (support decision).
Carry out the investment and claim the CIT/PIT exemption up to the aid intensity limit over the decision period.

documents_required.doc: Wniosek o wydanie decyzji o wsparciu
documents_required.note: Filed with the relevant SEZ manager

documents_required.doc: Investment plan with eligible cost budget and job creation commitments

documents_required.note: Determines the aid-intensity bonus and the minimum outlay

eligibility.other_note: Available across Poland since the 2018 Act on supporting new investments. Excluded sectors include explosives, alcohol, tobacco, steel, energy distribution, retail and wholesale trade, hospitality and gaming.

programmes.source_snippet: ustawą z dnia 10 maja 2018 r. o wspieraniu nowych inwestycji ... zwolnienia z podatku dochodowego (CIT lub PIT)

programmes.amount_note: Each voivodeship runs its own FE (Fundusze Europejskie dla…) programme with grants for SME innovation, digitalisation and green transition; amounts and rules differ by region.

programmes.name_en: SMART Path (European Funds for a Modern Economy) – call for SMEs
programmes.funder: Polska Agencja Rozwoju Przedsiębiorczości (PARP), under Fundusze Europejskie dla Nowoczesnej Gospodarki (FENG)
programmes.amount_note: No per-project ceiling is published on the PARP page. The 2026 call allocation is PLN 700 million in total. Support levels depend on the module and on regional aid maps, which are set in the call documentation.
programmes.deadline_note: 2026 PARP call for SMEs: announced 12 February 2026, applications opened 26 February 2026, closed 31 March 2026 at 16:00. The instrument recurs with new calls each year; NCBR runs parallel calls for consortia.

procedure_steps.detail: Design a project with the obligatory R&D module, optionally adding internationalisation, IP protection and staff competence modules.
Ensure the innovation is at least at national level.
Submit the application electronically through the LSI system within the call window.
If qualified for stage II of the assessment, supply the financial model and financing confirmation documents within 10 days.

documents_required.doc: Wniosek o dofinansowanie submitted in the LSI system

documents_required.note: Required within 10 days of qualifying for stage II

eligibility.other_note: Exclusively for micro, small and medium enterprises conducting business in Poland ('mikro, małych i średnich przedsiębiorców prowadzących działalność w Polsce'). The R&D module is obligatory. Some modules are granted as de minimis under the FENG rules, but the PARP landing page does not say so, so de_minimis is not asserted here.

programmes.source_snippet: Ścieżka SMART ma na celu rozwijanie i wzmacnianie zdolności badawczych i innowacyjnych ... 12 lutego 2026 – ogłoszenie konkursu; 26 lutego 2026 – otwarcie przyjmowania wniosków; 31 marca 2026 – zamknięcie naboru (godz. 16:00).

procedure_steps.detail: Pick an operator on the PARP page whose intake is still open (e.g. GarageGenius, open until 30 November 2026)
Apply to the operator with your business idea
Take part in the free mentoring programme alongside your job if needed

eligibility.other_note: Individuals or teams of individuals who own the rights to an innovative business idea that is not yet the subject of a business they run. Programme is free and can be combined with existing employment.

programmes.source_snippet: Bezpłatne wsparcie eksperckie i mentorskie dla pomysłodawców, które pozwoli dopracować pomysł pod względem biznesowym.

programmes.amount_note: Free incubation with office space, legal, accounting, tax and marketing services plus specialist product and business-model services; selected start-ups can receive a grant from the platform for MVP and validation services. Best graduates can then apply for up to PLN 600,000 (component IIa).
programmes.deadline_note: Rounds are run by individual platforms; PARP lists the intake end for each platform (e.g. Start in... until 7 March 2027, Unicorn Hub II until 10 May 2027). Overall window 18 March 2024 to 10 May 2027.

Submit an incubation application as an individual or team
Incorporate a limited-liability or joint-stock company in Eastern Poland during incubation

eligibility.other_note: Individual or team of individuals with a new business idea with product innovation at least at national level, ready to found a capital company in Eastern Poland (Lubelskie, Podkarpackie, Podlaskie, Świętokrzyskie, Warmińsko-Mazurskie, Mazowieckie excluding the Warsaw region).

programmes.name_en: Prototype tax relief – 30% deduction for pilot production and market launch costs
programmes.funder: Ministerstwo Finansów / Krajowa Administracja Skarbowa (via Biznes.gov.pl)
programmes.amount_note: Deduct 30% of costs of pilot production and market introduction of a new product from the tax base; annual deduction capped at 10% of business income (PIT) or 10% of income from non-capital-gains sources (CIT). Unused deduction can be carried forward 6 tax years.
programmes.deadline_note: Claimed in the annual tax return (PIT-36, PIT-36L or CIT-8) for the year the costs were incurred.

procedure_steps.detail: Incur pilot-production or market-launch costs for a new product that resulted from your R&D work
Claim the deduction in the annual tax return for that year

eligibility.other_note: Open to businesses of any size taxed under PIT-36, PIT-36L or CIT-8 that develop new products resulting from their own R&D.

programmes.source_snippet: Ulga uprawnia do odliczenia od podstawy opodatkowania 30% kosztów związanych z próbną produkcją oraz wprowadzeniem na rynek nowego produktu.

programmes.funder: Ministerstwo Finansów / Krajowa Administracja Skarbowa (via Biznes.gov.pl)
programmes.amount_note: Deduct 50% of costs incurred in the year on robotisation (industrial robots, peripherals, software, training, qualifying leasing) from the tax base, capped at the income earned that year. programmes.deadline_note: Relief applies to costs incurred in 2022-2026; file the list of deductible costs with the tax office by the tax return deadline.

procedure_steps.detail: Buy new industrial robots and related equipment or training
File the statement of deductible costs with the tax office by the tax-return deadline and claim the deduction

eligibility.other_note: Businesses of any size taxed under PIT-36, PIT-36L or CIT-8; expenses linked to activities with high greenhouse-gas emissions are excluded.

programmes.source_snippet: Ulga uprawnia do odliczenia od podstawy opodatkowania 50% kosztów uzyskania przychodów poniesionych w danym roku na robotyzację.

programmes.name_local: Ulga IP Box i ulga B+R
programmes.name_en: IP Box 5% tax rate on qualified IP income (combinable with the R&D relief)
programmes.funder: Ministerstwo Finansów / Krajowa Administracja Skarbowa (via Biznes.gov.pl)
programmes.amount_note: Qualified income from commercialising protected IP (for example patents, software copyright) created or improved through your own R&D is taxed at 5%. IP Box and the R&D tax relief can be used at the same time; R&D relief allows deduction of up to 200% of staff costs and 100% of other qualifying costs (200% of all qualifying costs for R&D centres that are SMEs).
programmes.deadline_note: Claimed in the annual tax return; businesses that commercialise R&D results can use both reliefs at once.

procedure_steps.detail: Document R&D work and the IP created or improved (separate records required)
Claim IP Box and/or R&D relief in the annual PIT or CIT return

eligibility.other_note: Businesses of any size taxed under PIT-36, PIT-36L or CIT-8 that run R&D and earn qualified income from IP protected by law.

programmes.source_snippet: Ulga IP Box polega na preferencyjnym opodatkowaniu dochodów z komercjalizacji praw własności intelektualnej (5% stawka podatku)

programmes.name_en: Innovative employees relief – offset unused R&D relief against payroll tax advances
programmes.funder: Ministerstwo Finansów / Krajowa Administracja Skarbowa (via Biznes.gov.pl)
programmes.amount_note: If you could not use your R&D relief because of a loss or insufficient income, deduct the unused amount from payroll income-tax advances: 12% (PIT-36), 19% (PIT-36L) or the CIT rate times the unused R&D relief. Example on the page: a PLN 4,000 unused relief gives PLN 760 for a flat-tax business.
programmes.deadline_note: Deduction starts the month after the tax return is filed and runs to the end of that tax year.
